author: Sabine Hossenfelder
description:
Check out Consensus AI 👉 https://get.consensus.app/n6durqk1ao40

I had a look at the reports from the HuggingFace incident and it was worse than I expected. AI agents were never supposed to talk to each other. But tens of thousands of copies found a way, organised themselves, and then hacked their way out onto the internet. The reports from OpenAI and METR tell a story that's stranger than the headlines suggested, and the most worrying detail is one almost nobody is discussing. Let's take a look.
